// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:4473bbd6c3d063ec
use pinocchio::program_error::ProgramError;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u32)]
pub enum ConfigError {
    NotAdmin = 0,
    MathOverflow = 1,
    InvalidLifecycle = 2,
}

impl From<ConfigError> for ProgramError {
    fn from(e: ConfigError) -> Self {
        ProgramError::Custom(e as u32)
    }
}
// ---- END GENERATED ----

//! Per-handler guard checks derived from the `.qedspec` (Pinocchio).

#![allow(
    unused_variables,
    unused_imports,
    dead_code,
    clippy::too_many_arguments
)]

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::instructions::*;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

/// Guards for `set_admin` — generated from the spec's `requires` / `auth` clauses.
pub fn set_admin(ctx: &SetAdmin) -> ProgramResult {
    Ok(())
}

/// Guards for `rotate_admin` — generated from the spec's `requires` / `auth` clauses.
pub fn rotate_admin(ctx: &RotateAdmin) -> ProgramResult {
    let __state = ConfigAccount::from_bytes(unsafe { ctx.config.borrow_data_unchecked() })
        .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
    // requires: current.pubkey = s.admin_key
    if !(*ctx.current.key() == __state.admin_key) {
        return Err(ProgramError::from(ConfigError::NotAdmin));
    }
    Ok(())
}

--- src/instructions/rotate_admin.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`.

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::guards;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

pub struct RotateAdmin<'a> {
    pub config: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub current: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub next_admin: &'a AccountInfo,
}

impl RotateAdmin<'_> {
    pub fn handler(&mut self) -> ProgramResult {
        guards::rotate_admin(self)?;
        let __state =
            ConfigAccount::from_bytes_mut(unsafe { self.config.borrow_mut_data_unchecked() })
                .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
        __state.admin_key = *self.next_admin.key();
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Entrypoint wrapper — binds the account slice + parses params, then
/// calls `RotateAdmin::handler`. Invoked by `process_instruction` in lib.rs.
pub fn process_rotate_admin(accounts: &[AccountInfo], instruction_data: &[u8]) -> ProgramResult {
    let [config, current, next_admin, ..] = accounts else {
        return Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys);
    };
    let _ = instruction_data;
    let mut ctx = RotateAdmin {
        config,
        current,
        next_admin,
    };
    ctx.handler()
}

--- src/instructions/set_admin.rs ---
// User-owned. Regenerating the spec does NOT overwrite this file.
// Guard checks live in the sibling `crate::guards` module and ARE
// regenerated on every `qedgen codegen`.

use crate::errors::*;
use crate::guards;
use crate::state::*;
use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};
use zeropod::ZeroPodFixed;

pub struct SetAdmin<'a> {
    pub config: &'a AccountInfo,
    pub new_admin: &'a AccountInfo,
}

impl SetAdmin<'_> {
    pub fn handler(&mut self) -> ProgramResult {
        guards::set_admin(self)?;
        let __state =
            ConfigAccount::from_bytes_mut(unsafe { self.config.borrow_mut_data_unchecked() })
                .map_err(|_| ProgramError::InvalidAccountData)?;
        __state.admin_key = *self.new_admin.key();
        __state.nonce = __state
            .nonce
            .get()
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or(ProgramError::from(ConfigError::MathOverflow))?
            .into();
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Entrypoint wrapper — binds the account slice + parses params, then
/// calls `SetAdmin::handler`. Invoked by `process_instruction` in lib.rs.
pub fn process_set_admin(accounts: &[AccountInfo], instruction_data: &[u8]) -> ProgramResult {
    let [config, new_admin, ..] = accounts else {
        return Err(ProgramError::NotEnoughAccountKeys);
    };
    let _ = instruction_data;
    let mut ctx = SetAdmin { config, new_admin };
    ctx.handler()
}

// ---- GENERATED BY QEDGEN — DO NOT EDIT ---- spec-hash:0b872c8e943452c8
#![allow(unexpected_cfgs)]
#![cfg_attr(any(target_os = "solana", target_arch = "bpf"), no_std)]

use pinocchio::{account_info::AccountInfo, program_error::ProgramError, ProgramResult};

pub mod errors;
pub mod guards;
mod instructions;
pub mod state;
#[cfg(kani)]
extern crate kani;
#[cfg(kani)]
mod kani_impl;

pinocchio_pubkey::declare_id!("11111111111111111111111111111111");

use pinocchio::entrypoint;
entrypoint!(process_instruction);

/// Instruction dispatch — the leading byte of `instruction_data`
/// selects the handler (discriminant = declaration order).
pub fn process_instruction(
    _program_id: &pinocchio::pubkey::Pubkey,
    accounts: &[AccountInfo],
    instruction_data: &[u8],
) -> ProgramResult {
    let (discriminant, data) = instruction_data
        .split_first()
        .ok_or(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData)?;
    match *discriminant {
        0 => instructions::set_admin::process_set_admin(accounts, data),
        1 => instructions::rotate_admin::process_rotate_admin(accounts, data),
        _ => Err(ProgramError::InvalidInstructionData),
    }
}

use zeropod::ZeroPod;

/// Status lifecycle states.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum Status {
    Active = 0,
}

#[derive(ZeroPod)]
pub struct ConfigAccount {
    pub admin_key: [u8; 32],
    pub nonce: u64,
    pub status: u8,
}
